desc: The Retay RXP22 is a double/single action pistol chambered in 22 LR. Models in this line feature a 4" barrel, 18, 10 and 13 round capacity options, black synthetic, black, olive drab green and flat dark earth grips and target style adjustable sights. The line is offered in matte black, flat dark earth, black, blue, gray, olive drab green and pink finishes. Additional features include reversable magazine release, intergrated picatinny rail and incl. aegis sentinel s red dot.
